curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a dangerous criminal piece together a murdered agent's thoughts in time to stop a catastrophic missile launch?
curatedMovie.description: After CIA operative Bill Pope is mysteriously killed pursuing a shadowy hacker, an experimental medical procedure implants his memories into an volatile ex-convict to complete the mission.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and tense sci-fi espionage with high-pressure stakes, best suited for focused solo viewing or movie night with friends.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Ariel Vromen delivers an urgent sci-fi crime hybrid where high-stakes geopolitical dread collides with a chaotic, memory-spliced manhunt.
